identity_effective_interval.start: list_session is the inclusive date on which the listed security identity begins to be effective
identity_effective_interval.end: delist_session is the exclusive delisting-effective date, not the last date with a market_daily row
identity_effective_interval.market_history_clipping: these identity bounds do not authorize PR1 to crop or synthesize market_daily history

status.meaning: the source/current listing-status observation stored with this identity row
status.not_a_promise: status is not historical PIT eligibility, tradability, or a replacement for a future security_status domain

fields.name: delist_session
fields.unit: Asia/Shanghai calendar date, exclusive delisting-effective boundary

validation: rows are emitted in declared sort order
symbol is canonical and its suffix matches the finite canonical exchange value
delist_session is not earlier than list_session when both are present
